notice: Reviewed playable legend identities independent of tournament presets. Registry IDs are stable; source facts alone do not establish runtime conformance. The four published lists remain unchanged.

legends.name: Blade Dancer
legends.text:
When you choose a friendly unit, you may exhaust me and pay [Any Power] to ready it.
When you conquer, you may pay [1 Energy] to ready me.
legends.rules_html:
When you choose a friendly unit, you may exhaust me and pay :rb_rune_rainbow: to ready it.
When you conquer, you may pay :rb_energy_1: to ready me.

legends.name: Wuju Bladesman, Starter
legends.text: While a friendly unit defends alone, it gets +2 Might.
legends.rules_html: While a friendly unit defends alone, it gets +2 :rb_might:.

legends.name: Heart of the Tempest
legends.text:
When you play a card from anywhere other than your hand, empower me.
[Action][>] Disempower me, [Exhaust]: Give a unit [Assault 2] this turn. (+2 Might while it's an attacker.)
legends.rules_html:
When you play a card from anywhere other than your hand, empower me.
[Action][>] Disempower me, :rb_exhaust:: Give a unit [Assault 2] this turn. (+2 :rb_might: while it's an attacker.)

legends.name: Daughter of the Void
legends.text: [Exhaust]: [Reaction] — [Add] [Any Power]. Use only to play spells. (Abilities that add resources can't be reacted to.)
legends.rules_html: :rb_exhaust:: [Reaction] — [Add] :rb_rune_rainbow:. Use only to play spells. (Abilities that add resources can't be reacted to.)

legends.name: Hand of Noxus
legends.text: [Exhaust]: [Reaction], [Legion] — [Add] [1 Energy]. (Abilities that add resources can't be reacted to. Get the effect if you've played a card this turn.)
legends.rules_html: :rb_exhaust:: [Reaction], [Legion] — [Add] :rb_energy_1:. (Abilities that add resources can't be reacted to. Get the effect if you've played a card this turn.)

legends.name: Herald of the Arcane
legends.text: [1 Energy], [Exhaust]: Play a 1 Might Recruit unit token.

legends.name: Lady of Luminosity, Starter
legends.text: When you play a spell that costs [5 Energy] or more, draw 1.
legends.rules_html: When you play a spell that costs :rb_energy_5: or more, draw 1.

legends.name: Matriarch of War
legends.text:
When you empower something else, empower me. (I become Empowered if I'm not already.)
Disempower me, [Any Power], [Exhaust]: Ready a unit.
legends.rules_html:
When you empower something else, empower me. (I become Empowered if I'm not already.)
Disempower me, :rb_rune_rainbow:, :rb_exhaust:: Ready a unit.

legends.name: Pridestalker
legends.text: When you play a unit, give a unit +1 Might this turn.
legends.rules_html: When you play a unit, give a unit +1 :rb_might: this turn.

legends.name: Prodigal Explorer
legends.text: [Exhaust]: [Reaction] — Draw 1. Use only if you've chosen enemy units and/or gear twice this turn with spells or unit abilities.
legends.rules_html: :rb_exhaust:: [Reaction] — Draw 1. Use only if you've chosen enemy units and/or gear twice this turn with spells or unit abilities.
